name: Can crown molding be added to existing kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can crown molding be added to existing kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, crown molding can be added directly over existing cabinetry to eliminate awkward gaps, create a custom built-in aesthetic, and finish off a kitchen remodel. Installation requires securing nailer blocks or an integrated sub-fascia along the cabinet tops to give the molding solid structural backing. The primary tradeoff to consider is ceiling clearance; if your cabinet tops sit unevenly below the ceiling, a two-piece riser and crown assembly allows carpenters to adjust for ceiling variance without twisting the molding face.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, adding crown molding to cabinets gives them a built-in look. Carpenters attach top nailer framing to anchor the trim and use risers to accommodate ceiling height variations.
